revision_semantics: Content fingerprint excludes observations. Ordered source observations retain recurrence and source lineage; earliest content observation is preserved.
availability_semantics: operational selects last actual observation; vendor selects vendor time then observation time, tied incompatible content fails. Universe selects a complete reconstructed state.
missing_semantics: null retains explicit missing reason; no forward fill across revisions
interval_semantics: [effective_from,effective_to); conflict/overlap within group and symbol at one knowledge cutoff fails
group_state_storage: DomainCommit.group_states: ordered complete states with counts, set digests, intervals and source refs; zero members is valid
